title: Electro
tagline: Machine funk, programmed rhythms, and the robotic pulse of early electronic dance music.
summary: Electro developed in the early 1980s through the meeting of electronic instruments, funk, and hip-hop culture. Drum machines and synthesizers gave producers a precise, futuristic sound, while DJs and dancers brought it into clubs and street scenes. Electro influenced later techno, house, and electronic pop.

pillars.name: Afrika Bambaataa
pillars.why: Afrika Bambaataa's Planet Rock connected electronic production with hip-hop and helped popularize electro.

pillars.name: Kraftwerk
pillars.why: Kraftwerk's machine-like compositions and electronic instrumentation were a major influence on electro producers.

pillars.name: Cybotron
pillars.why: Cybotron fused Detroit's electronic futurism with dance rhythms in recordings that influenced electro and techno.
